title: MA61035: Queuing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Probability and StatisticsMarkov chains, Poisson
process, birth-death Process, Simple Markovian queuing
models - M/M/1,
M/M/1/N, M/M/C, transient behaviour of M/M/1 and M/M/1/N queue. Models with
general arrival or service - M/G/1, GI/M/1. Concept bulk queues, network of
Markovian queues. General concept of discrete time queues, system reliability,
Markovian models in reliability theory. Life testing using the exponential and
Weibull models. Elementary inventory models, deterministic and stochastic
models, inventory models with price breaks, concept of just-in-time
inventory.
